properties.label: APOLLO CAHORA BASSA 2
properties.sapp_note: HVDC to the Cahora Bassa dam. Two 533 kV circuits, 1,920 MW nameplate - the single largest import into South Africa and the basis of FIXED.importsMW.

properties.label: PHOKOJE INSUKAMINI 1
properties.sapp_note: Phokoje-Insukamini 400 kV, Botswana to Zimbabwe. Does NOT touch South Africa - it is the onward leg of the central SAPP corridor, shown because it is what makes the Matimba-Phokoje link a regional route rather than a bilateral one.

properties.label: ARIES KOKERBOOM 1

properties.label: ARNOT MAPUTO 1
properties.sapp_note: Motraco 400 kV, jointly owned by Eskom, EDM and the Eswatini Electricity Company. Built to serve the Mozal smelter; also carries regional trade.

properties.label: CAMDEN EDWALENI 1

properties.label: EDWALENI MAPUTO 1

properties.label: MATIMBA PHOKOJE 1

LESOTHO IS ABSENT BY SCOPE, NOT OMISSION: the SA-Lesotho links run at 132 kV (Muela hydro and Eskom into Maputsoe and Mabote substations) and this dataset's lowest voltage is 220 kV. Eskom's TDP lists Lesotho among its interconnections, so any future 132 kV layer should add it.
